explanation: For Playtime (1967), Tati built a vast glass-and-steel set near Paris, nicknamed Tativille. Its cost helped drive him into bankruptcy.

claims.text: Jacques Tati created and played Monsieur Hulot.
Jacques Demy, Louis de Funès and Pierre Étaix did not create or play Monsieur Hulot.
For Playtime (1967), Tati built a huge modern set near Paris, nicknamed Tativille.
The cost of Playtime contributed to Tati's later bankruptcy.
